Strategic Security Systems (S3) is an Uzbekistan-based systems integrator delivering advanced, secure, and mission-oriented solutions to government and defense customers.

Global Technology. Local Integration.
Illustrative imagery

Working with leading international technology partners, we combine combat-proven technologies, systems integration expertise, professional training, and local lifecycle support to transform advanced technology into sustainable operational capability.

Strategic Security Systems

From Technology to
Operational Capability

Modern operations depend on more than individual products. Communications, networks, command and control systems, sensors, platforms, and other technologies must work together reliably and securely.

S3 brings these elements together.

We work with our customers and technology partners to understand operational requirements, select appropriate technologies, integrate new capabilities with existing systems and infrastructure, and support their effective deployment and use.

Our approach covers the complete solution lifecycle — from requirements analysis and system design to integration, deployment, training, knowledge transfer, and ongoing support.

Our Core
Capabilities

Secure Tactical Communications

Secure and reliable communications for mission-critical environments.

S3 provides integrated tactical radio communication and networking solutions supporting secure voice and data exchange across operational teams, mobile platforms, command posts, and wider tactical networks.

Learn More ↗
Command & Control (C2)

Connecting people, information, and operational systems.

Our C2 solutions support situational awareness, information sharing, coordination, and decision-making, helping users establish a common operational picture across different levels of an organization.

Learn More ↗
Fire Support & Targeting

Integrated technologies supporting the timely and reliable exchange of targeting and fire-support information.

S3 brings together communications, positioning, networking, and command-and-control capabilities to support coordinated operations and effective information exchange.

Mission-Critical Systems

S3's capabilities extend beyond our core solution areas.

Working with our technology partners, we can provide and integrate solutions in areas including SATCOM, tactical data networks, ISR, UAV integration, electronic warfare, cybersecurity, command-post infrastructure, and deployable communication systems.

Systems Integration

Integration Is at the Core
of What We Do

Strategic Security Systems

S3 is not simply an equipment supplier.

As a systems integrator, we focus on bringing technologies together into complete solutions designed around the customer's operational requirements.

Where appropriate, new technologies can be integrated with existing customer systems, networks, and infrastructure — helping organizations introduce new capabilities while making effective use of their existing investments.

Our objective is to deliver solutions that are secure, interoperable, reliable, scalable, and sustainable throughout their operational lifecycle.

Training & Knowledge Transfer

Knowledge Builds
Capability

Technology achieves its full value when people know how to use, administer, maintain, and support it.

For this reason, training and knowledge transfer are integral parts of the solutions we deliver.

S3 provides Operator Training, Administrator Training, Technical and Maintenance Training, and Train-the-Trainer (ToT) programs, helping customers develop the internal knowledge and practical skills required to operate and support their systems effectively.

Training & Knowledge Transfer↗
Support & FSR Services

Local Support.
International Expertise.

Mission-critical systems require dependable support beyond initial delivery and deployment.

S3 provides ongoing technical and operational support for the solutions we deliver. Where required, our Field Service Representative (FSR) model provides customers with local access to experienced specialists combining technical expertise with relevant military and operational experience.

Through troubleshooting, technical assistance, knowledge sharing, training support, and coordination with our technology partners, we remain engaged throughout the operational lifecycle of the solution.
